items.title: Maintenance: dashboard and API upgrade
items.body:
### Summary

We are upgrading OpenStack. The dashboard and API will be unavailable during the window.

- Running instances are **not** affected
- Plan changes to your infrastructure before or after the window

See the [documentation](https://docs.nrec.no) for details.
